kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: AI giant Anthropic files for an IPO that could break records
wire.summary: The AI company, which makes the popular Claude chatbot, has filed for an initial public offering that could be one of the biggest ever.

wire.title: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban
wire.summary: Andre McKechnie, 55, is serving a life sentence for murder. He took his battle for the salty, sticky, black-brown byproduct of brewing beer to the court last year. He argued being refused Vegemite breached the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act.

wire.title: What to know about China's plenum as Xi seeks stronger party discipline
wire.summary: This closed-door gathering that started Monday comes about a year before Xi is expected to secure a fourth term and personnel changes to key leadership bodies.

wire.title: Redistricting isn't playing out how the GOP hoped. And, Brazil's Lula wins 4th term
wire.summary: Republicans are spending millions on the midterms, and they still may not win districts drawn to favor them. And, Brazil's Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term in a stunning political comeback.

wire.title: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks against El-Sayed in Michigan
wire.summary: President Trump intensified his anti-Muslim rhetoric against Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday, portraying him as a threat to national security and questioning his loyalty to the United States.

wire.title: How AI is transforming hurricane forecasts
wire.summary: Hurricane forecasters are increasingly using artificial intelligence to make predictions.

wire.title: Special ed diaries: Teachers tell NPR about their most joyous, most difficult moments
wire.summary: What makes special education teaching jobs so hard to fill? NPR set out to find some answers by talking to more than a dozen teachers who do this work every day.

wire.title: Loggers say Roadless Rule repeal won't solve their biggest challenges
wire.summary: President Trump is planning to open up some of the nation's last pristine forests to road building and timber companies. But those who work in the woods say it won't do enough to revive the industry.

wire.title: Republicans are spending millions and still may not win districts drawn to favor them
wire.summary: Republicans redrew congressional district lines to try to tilt the midterms in their favor. But now they are facing expensive and competitive races they had hoped to outmaneuver.

wire.title: Court ruling fails to end wait for thousands of immigrants stuck abroad without visas
wire.summary: A federal judge struck down a Trump administration ban on issuing immigrant visas to people from 75 countries, but immigrants continue to be stuck in their countries.

wire.title: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
wire.summary: The left-wing incumbent president had lost the first round to right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro.

wire.title: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
wire.summary: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

wire.title: Chris Brown given suspended eight-month prison sentence over nightclub attack
wire.summary: The R&B star previously pleaded guilty to affray, after attacking a music producer with a glass bottle.

wire.title: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing
wire.summary: The company will be the first true artificial intelligence company to go public as tech firms continue to invest heavily in AI.

wire.title: Catholic bishops apologise for 'exploited' Trump meeting
wire.summary: Two bishops in images that show them praying with Trump have said they believed the meeting was private.

wire.title: US Marine indicted for murder and robbery of woman in Japan
wire.summary: Prosecutors have indicted Devin Jacob Ballard for a killing that has caused outrage in Japan, local media reports.
